raw_text: We analysed the viral ISPR video using our deepfake detection pipeline combining DIRE (Diffusion Reconstruction Error), frequency-domain analysis, and temporal consistency metrics. The video scores 0.94 on our deepfake probability scale, indicating near-certain synthetic generation. Key findings: (1) the facial boundary exhibits GAN-characteristic frequency artifacts in the DCT domain, (2) eye-blink patterns deviate significantly from natural human baselines at p<0.001, (3) the audio-visual sync error exceeds 120ms in multiple segments, well above the 40ms human perceptual threshold. This case study highlights the weaponisation of consumer-grade deepfake tools for state-level information operations during election cycles. We recommend election commissions adopt mandatory AI-content disclosure frameworks.
